meta.name: Apsara
meta.description: Braving modern-day evils, power-blessed Sunheri is the sole protector of her celestial clan! But her blood sister Dhara stands in her way! Can she fight her?

videos.title: The Birth of Sunheri and Dhara
videos.overview: Rani Meenakshi gives birth to Sunheri and Dhara amid Nirati's deadly attack. As fate separates the sisters at birth, their extraordinary journeys begin.

videos.title: Saira's Deceptive Care for Dhara
videos.overview: Sunheri faces her aunt's taunts and misses her parents. Elsewhere, Saira secretly uses magic to disrupt Dhara's birthday preparations but pretends to care for her.

videos.title: Saira's Scheme for Divyalok
videos.overview: Chitra asks Tilotama to watch Dhara as her Apsara tattoo glows at 21. Meanwhile, Saira explains sparing Dhara to gain Divyalok's elixir and an Apsara queen.

videos.title: A Special Day for Dhara
videos.overview: Chitra notices Sunehri's tattoo as Saira plots to trap Dhara's magic. Meanwhile, Shaurya dismisses Dhara's birthday excitement, revealing that his mother chose her.

videos.title: Sunheri's Magical Powers Emerge
videos.overview: Saira makes Dhara wear anklets to suppress her powers. Meanwhile, Sunheri's powers awaken on her 21st birthday, allowing her to stop a metro from crashing on a broken track.

videos.title: Chitra's Claims Shock Sunheri
videos.overview: Sunheri regains consciousness but dismisses Chitra's claims about Apsara's and Sunheri's parents. Shaurya arrives at Dhara's birthday party, but she feels ignored.

videos.title: Chitra Reveals Sunheri's Past
videos.overview: Chitra reveals her identity to Sunheri, who refuses to believe her. Meanwhile, Tilotama starts a fire, but Shaurya rescues Dhara as Chitra reveals Sunheri's past.

videos.title: Sunahri Finds Dhara
videos.overview: Chitra explains the glowing tattoo while Dhara forcefully takes Shaurya on a drive. Meanwhile, guided by Chitra's magical vision, Sunheri goes to her birthplace and finds Dhara.

videos.title: Sunheri's Vow to Defeat Saira
videos.overview: Sunheri helps Dhara with magic and vows revenge on Saira. Dhara prepares to propose to Shaurya, who uses an earring as a clue to investigate the mysterious flickering lights.

videos.title: Sunheri's Magic Lesson
videos.overview: Unable to control her magic after learning the truth, Sunheri hurts and heals Chitra. Meanwhile, Dhara tracks Shaurya to the temple, leaving a hidden Sunheri emotional.

videos.title: Shaurya's Anger Upsets Dhara
videos.overview: Sunheri plans to use Shaurya to save Dhara from Saira's trap. Shaurya gets furious when Dhara confronts him for ignoring her, prompting Saira to comfort a distressed Dhara.

videos.title: Sunheri Secretly Watches Dhara
videos.overview: Sunheri uses magic to cheer up Dhara and slips away before Shaurya spots her. Sunheri attends an interview, unaware of Mishra's intentions, while Chitra and Tilotama help her.

videos.title: Sunheri Saves Shaurya from Danger
videos.overview: Sunheri loses control of her magic upon seeing Saira. Though she saves Shaurya from the collapsing ceiling, her plan to reach the Kapoor house fails.

videos.title: Chitra Guides Sunheri
videos.overview: Sunheri tells Chitra she cannot heal herself with magic, but the latter explains the strength and patience required. Further, Shaurya updates Sunheri about Dhara's injury.

videos.title: Dhara's Accusation against Sunheri
videos.overview: Shaurya confides in Anjali about his lack of feelings for Dhara. Sunheri enters the Kapoor house, where Shaurya spots her, and Dhara accuses her of being a thief.

videos.title: Sunheri Faces Dhara's Wrath
videos.overview: Sunheri seeks a job from Saira but faces rejection and further endures Dhara's rude behaviour. Later, the Kapoors welcome the guests as Shaurya offers to help Sunheri.

videos.title: Saira Finds Out About Sunheri
videos.overview:
Dhara takes off Saira's magical anklet after an injury, unleashing alarming powers. Later, Adhree approaches Saira in disguise to inform Saira

that the girl is Sunheri.

videos.title: Saira Offers Sunheri a Job
videos.overview: Saira apologises and offers Sunheri a job to plan Diya's wedding, asking her to move in. Later, she instructs Adhree about Sunheri's sacrifice to regain her dark powers.

videos.title: Sunheri Enters Saira House
videos.overview: Saira allows Sunheri to stay as Diya's wedding planner despite Dhara's anger. Later, Dhara fumes as Shaurya saves Sunheri from falling and helps her gather dropped flowers.

videos.title: Shaurya's Confession to Saira
videos.overview: Sunheri uses magic to change the backdrop flower to save herself from Malini's trap. Further, Malini's manipulation and Shaurya's confession leave Dhara heartbroken.

videos.title: Dhara Plot against Sunheri
videos.overview: Dhara seeks Sunheri's help, while Shaurya tries to impress her with dance but falls. Dhara recommends Sunheri as a choreographer as a plot to frame her later.

videos.title: Dhara Accuses Sunheri
videos.overview: Shaurya gets Sunheri to practise dancing, while Dhara secretly sabotages her dress. Sunheri uses magic to avert disaster but faces baseless accusations from Dhara and Malini.

videos.title: Shaurya Stands by Sunheri
videos.overview: Dhara blames Sunheri and demands her eviction, while Sunheri refuses the engagement ring. Shaurya finds the ring in Dhara's room and demands an apology to Sunheri.

videos.title: Shaurya Refuses to Marry Dhara
videos.overview: Warned by Adhree Saira plots a dark sacrifice during Diya's wedding. Elsewhere, Shaurya overhears Dhara confessing her ring trap against Sunheri and calls off their marriage.

videos.title: Shaurya Accepts Dhara's Proposal
videos.overview: Shaurya accepts Dhara's proposal, but Sunheri worries about his apparent lack of enthusiasm for the marriage. Meanwhile, Shaurya feels relieved after talking to her.

videos.title: Shaurya Confronts Dhara
videos.overview: Diya's wedding begins while Saira plots to abduct Sunheri. Dhara envies Sunheri and Shaurya but panics when he confronts her over the proposal as Chita and Tilottama sneak in.

videos.title: Sunheri Falls into Saira's Trap
videos.overview: Dhara questions Sunheri's intentions while Adhree kidnaps Sunheri. Soon, Shaurya searches for Sunheri as Saira plans to sacrifice her to regain her powers.

videos.title: Shaurya Tries to Save Sunheri
videos.overview: Diya and Chitra worry about Sunheri as Saira sets fire beneath her. Meanwhile, Shaurya risks his life by jumping into the flames to save Sunheri.

videos.title: Saira's Plan Backfires
videos.overview: Shaurya braves Saira's ring of fire to rescue Sunheri, foiling her sacrifice plan. Later, Dhara blames Sunheri for Shaurya's condition in a furious outburst.

videos.title: Saira Expels Sunheri from Her Job
videos.overview: Dismissed over her abduction truth Sunheri is fired from her job by a ruthless Saira. Later, Sunheri leads Chitra and Tilotama to the dark ritual site where Saira flees in a clash.

videos.title: A Trap for Saira
videos.overview: Sunheri, Chitra and Tilotama plot to lure a weakened Saira outside. Meanwhile, Saira uses magical bracelets to protect her doors from the Apsaras.

videos.title: Sunheri's Trap for Dhara
videos.overview: Sunheri lures Dhara to Dhamodar Market with a letter. Meanwhile, Dhara plans to catch her and Shaurya red-handed, while Saira rushes to find Dhara.

videos.title: Sunheri Saves Shaurya and Saira
videos.overview: Saira escapes Chitra and Sunheri but reaches Shaurya unconscious. Meanwhile, Sunheri protects Shaurya from Chitra, earning his gratitude for saving him and Saira.
